'library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#31333F"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "#808495"),
      text = element_text(colour = "#31333F"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#E6E9EF"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

# Bewertung (CAPE) vs. Kursrendite der folgenden 10 Jahre mit LOESS-Kurve
p <- dataset |>
  mutate(datum = as.Date(substr(as.character(Datum), 1, 10))) |>
  arrange(datum) |>
  mutate(
    rendite_10j = (lead(Index, 120) / Index)^(1 / 10) - 1,
    jahrzehnt = factor(floor(as.integer(format(datum, "%Y")) / 10) * 10)
  ) |>
  drop_na(rendite_10j, KGV10) |>
  ggplot(aes(KGV10, rendite_10j)) +
  geom_density_2d(colour = "#D5DAE5") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = jahrzehnt), size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", colour = "#FF2B2B", fill = "#FFABAB") +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "C", end = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Hohe Bewertung, tiefere Zukunftsrendite?",
    subtitle = "CAPE vs. annualisierte Kursrendite der n\u00e4chsten 10 Jahre",
    x = "Shiller-KGV (CAPE)",
    y = NULL,
    colour = "Jahrzehnt"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

print(p)
'
